testflight_external.description: Archive, upload and submit Crew App to its existing external TestFlight group; preserve the public link.

steps.name: archive
steps.run: asc xcode archive --workspace ios/RoyceTravelTemplate.xcworkspace --scheme RoyceTravelTemplate --configuration Release --archive-path '${steps.preflight.ARTIFACT_DIR}/CrewApp.xcarchive' --xcodebuild-flag=-destination --xcodebuild-flag=generic/platform=iOS --xcodebuild-flag=-derivedDataPath --xcodebuild-flag='${steps.preflight.ARTIFACT_DIR}/DerivedData' --xcodebuild-flag=-allowProvisioningUpdates --xcodebuild-flag=CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION=${steps.preflight.BUILD_NUMBER} --xcodebuild-flag=MARKETING_VERSION=${steps.preflight.VERSION} --output json

steps.name: export
steps.run: asc xcode export --archive-path '${steps.archive.ARCHIVE_PATH}' --ipa-path '${steps.preflight.ARTIFACT_DIR}/CrewApp.ipa' --method app-store-connect --signing-style automatic --team-id '${steps.preflight.TEAM_ID}' --timeout 10m --xcodebuild-flag=-allowProvisioningUpdates --output json

steps.name: review_receipt
steps.run: asc testflight review submissions list --build-id '${steps.upload.BUILD_ID}' --output json
